name: POFM, envois d'entraînement par correspondance (Animath)
files: files.tsv lists every local copy with the URL it was downloaded from
what_it_is: The problem sets mailed to students of the French olympiad preparation (POFM) during the
school year, five or six per year, each on one theme: géométrie, algèbre, arithmétique,
combinatoire, or a mixed pot-pourri. One statement file and one corrigé per mailing.
From 2019-2020 on, each mailing has three parts: Exercices Juniors, Exercices communs and
Exercices Seniors, about 18 problems. Before that, about 8 problems, often split the same way.

level.junior: 'Le groupe junior est constitué des élèves nés en 2010 ou après' (2024-2025), so juniors are collège students, at most 3e.
level.senior: Lycée students preparing for the international olympiads.
level.comment: Students are selected by the Coupe Animath d'automne, so even the junior problems are olympiad training, not school exercises.

how_it_was_enumerated: The page at ?page_id=71 was fetched once on 2026-09-30. Its table gives, per school year, the
theme of each mailing with its statement and corrigé links. All 136 PDFs were downloaded.
The 2018-2019 pot-pourri corrigé is hosted at igm.univ-mlv.fr, its local copy starts with juge_.
